title: Coastal Cove Beach Campground from Hilltop, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A high-angle vintage landscape photograph looking down from a hillside onto a secluded coastal cove and beach camp. Small cabins, camping tents, and parked vehicles are arranged along the sandy cove between steep coastal bluffs, with small boats moored in the calm bay water. The snapshot features decorative deckled edges characteristic of mid-century vacation and travel photography.
